# devhop
> Zero-config mobile dev proxy for testing local web apps on physical phones with live updates on save, Next.js Server Actions, and working microphone/camera permissions.

- CLI: `npx devhop [target]`
- Repo: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/devhop
- Docs: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop#readme

## Key Capabilities
- Live updates on save: Preserves the live WebSocket connection so phones refresh automatically when code is saved.
- Solves Next.js 14–16 `allowedDevOrigins` cross-origin blocking and Server Actions CSRF mismatch (`x-action-redirect`).
- Solves Vite 6 `server.allowedHosts` "host not allowed" 403 Forbidden errors.
- Grants Mobile Safari & Android Chrome full permissions for microphone (`getUserMedia`), camera, WebCrypto, and Passkeys via trusted HTTPS.
- Relabels Host, Origin, and Referer headers in-process to `localhost:<port>` so dev servers treat the phone as local loopback traffic.
- Tolerant input parsing: accepts raw ports (`3000`), `host:port`, URLs (`http://localhost:5173`), and container addresses (`0.0.0.0`).
- Generates compact Unicode terminal QR code for instant phone camera scanning.
- Agent-ready: provides `--json` flag for automated AI coding agent workflows.
- Corporate firewall bypass: `npx devhop [target] --http2` routes the tunnel over HTTP/2 (TCP 443) when UDP/QUIC is blocked.
- Zero signup, zero accounts, zero cloud config, zero system daemons.
